_comment: Sample cron-triggered output. No creatorId, no topic. Pro-tier TTL.

algoSignals.signal: TikTok is suppressing reposted-from-other-platforms content via watermark detection (April 2026).
algoSignals.evidence: per https://www.tubefilter.com/2026/04/15/tiktok-watermark-suppression: 'TikTok confirmed in a creator briefing that posts containing detected IG/Reels or YouTube watermarks are being downranked in For You distribution.' Date: 2026-04-15.

algoSignals.signal: TikTok now favors posts whose first 1.5s contains an explicit visual change (cut, zoom, text overlay).
algoSignals.evidence: per https://www.modernretail.com/marketing/tiktok-q1-2026-creator-data: 'Posts with a visual change in the first 1.5s saw 2.3x higher completion vs static-open posts in Q1 2026 internal aggregate.' Date: 2026-04-08.

output.whatsHotNow: Native, watermark-free posts with strong visual cuts in the first 1.5 seconds. Sound-on, first-frame motion, captioned overlays.
output.whatsCoolingOff: Cross-posted content with visible IG/YT watermarks. Static talking-head openings without visual change in the first 1.5s.
